ref_extractions.title: A Multimodal Neuroimaging Dataset to Study Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Visual Processing in Humans
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is the primary dataset descriptor paper for openneuro_ds002814. It explicitly describes the EEG recording from 21 participants during a one-back visual task with 5 object categories (animals, chairs, faces, fruits, vehicles), mentions stimulus onset triggers were sent via parallel port, and outlines the epoch extraction methodology. The paper serves as the authoritative source for stimulus timing and category labels used by the dataset.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Describes EEG recording with 80-channel g.HIamp at 1100Hz, 32 runs, 200ms stimulus presentation with 600ms ISI, parallel port triggers for trial onset, and explicit mapping of stimulus categories (animals/chairs/faces/fruits/vehicles) used in the experiment.

ref_extractions.title: A multivariate comparison of electroencephalogram and functional magnetic resonance imaging to electrocorticogram using visual object representations in humans
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This follow-up paper explicitly uses the same dataset (openneuro_ds002814) with identical stimulus set and 21 participants. It performs multivariate pattern analysis on EEG and fMRI data, directly classifies object category representations from EEG epochs, and reports category decoding results. The task is concrete with defined labels and evaluation metrics.
ref_extractions.epoch_params: tmin/tmax not explicitly stated but uses EEG epochs aligned to stimulus onset for category decoding
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Uses same 125 images (5 categories × 5 objects × 5 viewing conditions), 21 participants, same one-back task. Performs EEG-fMRI-ECoG comparison using multivariate pattern analysis, explicitly tests category decoding from EEG signals, reports temporal dynamics of category representations (100-300ms window).
